result.stdout:
Usage: spireloc action run baselib <namespace-top> <source-path> <game-path> [options]

Convert localization between BaseLib source and game directory layouts.

Parameters:
  <namespace-top>, --namespace-top <string>  Top-level BaseLib namespace. (required)
  <source-path>, --source-path <string>      Source localization directory. (required)
  <game-path>, --game-path <string>          Game localization directory. (required)
  --source-format <string>                   Structured source localization format. (default: yaml)
  --game-format <string>                     Game localization format. (default: flat-json)
  --minionlib-components                     Enable MinionLib component compatibility conversion. (default: false)
  --minionlib-namespace-top <string>         MinionLib component namespace; leave empty to use namespace-top. (default: "")
  --reversed                                 Convert game localization back to source form. (default: false)

Usage: spireloc action run ritsulib <mod-id> <source-path> <game-path> [options]

Convert localization between RitsuLib source and game directory layouts.

Parameters:
  <mod-id>, --mod-id <string>            Mod ID used by RitsuLib. (required)
  <source-path>, --source-path <string>  Source localization directory. (required)
  <game-path>, --game-path <string>      Game localization directory. (required)
  --source-format <string>               Structured source localization format. (default: yaml)
  --game-format <string>                 Game localization format. (default: flat-json)
  --minionlib-components                 Enable MinionLib component compatibility conversion. (default: false)
  --minionlib-namespace-top <string>     MinionLib component namespace; leave empty to use mod-id. (default: "")
  --disable-model-capabilities           Disable RitsuLib ModelCapability table separation and merging. (default: false)
  --reversed                             Convert game localization back to source form. (default: false)
